messages:
elaine_sales: NovaHealth POC: intermittent 504/502 when Python SDK + TS frontend hit our hosted endpoint through corporate proxy. Demo in 3 days, can we triage quickly?
ben_engineering: on it. do we have SDK versions and proxy host? my gut: connection reuse / proxy connection cap.
elaine_sales: python v0.9.3 (requests), ts v1.1.2. Proxy: https://proxy.sawtooth.local:8443, HTTPS_PROXY set, NO_PROXY not set. Fail rate ~5-10% under mixed load.
priya_support: common pattern. recommend using a Session with pooled adapter + retries in python. sample:
```
s = requests.Session()
s.mount('https://', HTTPAdapter(pool_maxsize=50, pool_block=True))
```
and set Retry with jitter for 429/502/504.
ravi_sre: also gather proxy logs for per-IP conn limits; try toggling NO_PROXY to bypass proxy. If NO_PROXY impossible, force keepAlive + bigger pool.
ben_engineering: node tip: const agent = new https.Agent({ keepAlive:true, maxSockets:50 }) ; pass to client. Dedicated won't fix corporate proxy but Private/VPC will.
deploybot: note: client-side changes only, no infra rollout required.
elaine_sales: action items: ben -> push python/ts samples and small repro script to toggle NO_PROXY; ravi -> proxy checklist; priya -> standby for customer call. I'll ask Nova to run repro tonight and share logs. Thanks team!
